content_of_post_to_comment: I've been using Instagram for more than four years, and I use it almost every hour of my day. But now it's becoming disturbing because it isn't just a habit anymore — it has become an addiction. I spend all my time doomscrolling through reels and doing nothing else. I've even started avoiding my daily activities just to scroll a little longer, and procrastination has become my new hobby. So last night, I decided to uninstall Instagram to start focusing on my daily activities and avoid getting distracted. I know it's not a big step, but it will affect my life, so I must take action, even if it's just a small step.
